# Tetelestai

> Tetelestai (Tetelestai Soluções em Tecnologia Ltda., CNPJ 58.138.258/0001-39) is a small technology studio based in Brasília, Brazil, that works online with clients across Brazil and abroad. It builds websites, landing pages and iOS/Android apps for businesses, publishes its own iOS apps, sells a guide for tech professionals applying to international jobs, and runs on-demand AI training. Contact is through WhatsApp (+55 61 98471-1930) or contato@tetelestai.tech.

## Key facts

- Landing page: R$ 697, paid in 2 × R$ 348.50 (half when hiring, half on delivery). One page with up to 5 sections, an offer and copy written for the business, SEO and GEO optimization, mobile version, WhatsApp button and one round of revisions. Live in up to 2 business days after the client sends texts and photos. The .com.br domain and hosting are included for the first 12 months; from the second year on, the annual renewal is paid by the business.
- Multi-page websites, iOS and Android apps, systems and automations are quoted in writing after a conversation.
- Founders: Carlos Viegas (Co-Founder & CTO; software engineer for more than 22 years, 14 of them as a tech lead at Banco do Brasil) and Gabriela Rosa (Co-Founder & CEO).
- Service is delivered online, in Portuguese or English, to clients across Brazil and abroad.
- The career guide and AI training do not guarantee interviews, hiring, salaries or visas, and do not include immigration legal advice.

## Pages (Portuguese)

- [Home](https://tetelestai.tech/): websites, landing pages and apps for businesses of any size across Brazil
- [Criação de sites](https://tetelestai.tech/criacao-de-sites/): multi-page business websites, quoted per project
- [Criação de landing pages](https://tetelestai.tech/criacao-de-landing-pages/): the R$ 697 landing page offer
- [Projetos](https://tetelestai.tech/projetos/): client websites and the De Rolê and Tempo de Recarga iOS apps
- [Infinity Car Studio](https://tetelestai.tech/projetos/infinity-car-studio/): car detailing website case study
- [Bolachinhas da Vovó Juju](https://tetelestai.tech/projetos/bolachinhas-da-vovo-juju/): artisan food landing page case study
- [Afeto Nobre](https://tetelestai.tech/projetos/afeto-nobre/): handmade sweets and cakes landing page case study (Guará, Brasília), with WhatsApp quotes
- [LaLeLis](https://tetelestai.tech/projetos/lalelis/): custom party stationery landing page case study (Federal District), with an interactive quote list sent through WhatsApp
- [Carreira internacional em TI](https://tetelestai.tech/carreira-internacional/): the Essencial guide (R$ 47, 31 pages, plain-text templates and a CSV tracker; optional Word CV and cover letter templates at checkout) and Acompanhado, one-on-one coaching with three 45-minute online sessions in 30 days, sold on Kiwify for R$ 497 and including the Essencial guide and the Word templates
- [Capacitação em IA](https://tetelestai.tech/capacitacao-em-ia/): on-demand AI training for teams and professionals
